name: Cacheable
solves: Provides a comprehensive, modular caching framework for Node.js with layer 1 (in-memory) and layer 2 (persistent) tiered caching, built on top of Keyv, with packages for cache management, HTTP request caching, file caching, LRU memory caching, and memoization utilities.
best_for: Node.js applications needing tiered L1/L2 caching with in-memory primary and Redis/database secondary stores
NestJS projects using cache-manager that need a maintained, modern cache-manager implementation
Applications requiring RFC-compliant HTTP request caching via cacheable-request
Projects needing a TypeScript-first drop-in replacement for node-cache with @cacheable/node-cache
Microservices that need flexible cache backends with Keyv adapter support and TTL management
skip_when: You only need a simple single-process LRU cache and want zero dependencies — use lru-cache instead
Your project is Python-based or non-Node.js
You need a distributed cache with built-in pub/sub and cluster support — use ioredis or Redis directly
You want a managed serverless caching service with zero infrastructure — consider Upstash Redis
Your caching needs are limited to browser/client-side storage rather than server-side
